name: freertos_port_patch
description: FreeRTOS Kernel V11.3.1 ARM_CM3 port with a PRIMASK/FAULTMASK workaround for the Wokwi simulator, whose `cpsie` sets those mask bits instead of clearing them. Without it, the `svc 0` at the end of prvPortStartFirstTask is masked and the first task never starts. Not archived, so its port.o is linked as an object and the FreeRTOS library archive's own port.o is never pulled in; if any port symbol were missing here, the link would fail with a duplicate definition instead of silently using the unpatched port.
